final:
I checked Linear and there is **no project that exactly matches all three criteria**:

| Project | Priority | Health | Meridian milestone |
|---|---|---|---|
| Driftwood | Low (4) | On track | — |
| Echo | High (2) | On track | Meridian, due **2026-10-05** |

So per your instruction, I didn't change anything. If you meant Harbor Mobile (high-priority + at-risk + Meridian milestone, just with the different date), say the word and I'll set its description to "Pivoting to usage-based pricing."
